aboutParagraphs: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with over 4 years of expertise in development and support. Passionate about developing tailor-made software with interactive user-friendly experience and sharing knowledge on current and emerging technologies with peers.

Committed to continuous learning and embracing new challenges, I specialize in full-stack engineering with .NET technologies (C#) on the backend and modern web frameworks like React and TypeScript on the frontend. I also possess extensive hands-on experience in cloud data engineering using Azure Databricks and Data Factory.
